evidence: Draft judged: 'It's got to lead somewhere!' The words replaced (SOURCE.txt) are 'And it's got to lead somewhere!', the working-copy line Joel approved. The only difference is the dropped 'And' and the capital I, which is exactly what the_change says. Meaning: unchanged. The line is still the demand that the practice lead to something real (his published 'A powerful state matters only if something survives it ...'); the 'And' only marked it as one more thing, and the paragraph break and the exclamation mark carry that turn without it. Nothing is added: no claim, fact, name or number. I do not think that tips it, because the words are plain and there is no antithesis, figure or rhyme. Here the section already uses a bare 'It' for the whole co-operation of the modes twice before ('It's not an electoral process.', 'It can be peaceful but also precise.'), and 'the adult can choose what to do next in the real world' just above sets up 'somewhere', so the referent is the same loose but clear one, and the approved line had the same 'it'.
